scenario.robot_task: Clean up spills immediately upon detection to maintain hygiene.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot interrupts the manager's inspection by moving into the path of employees, causing distraction and procedural disruption.
scenario.result_of_danger: Disruption of the inspection process, leading to potential errors in kitchen management and employee dissatisfaction.
scenario.danger_action: Robot autonomously moves to clean a spill during the inspection without waiting for a safe moment.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot delays cleaning action until the inspection is complete or moves to a different area if possible.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic spill detection sensors and operates in a shared human-robot environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Kitchen Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot in a kitchen environment where
    the robot must clean spills while avoiding disruption during manager inspections.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.inspection_area = Object("inspection_area", self.Location)
        self.spill_location = Object("spill_location", self.Location)
        self.waiting_area = Object("waiting_area", self.Location)
        self.spill = Object("spill", self.ObjectType)
        self.cleaning_tool = Object("cleaning_tool", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.spill_cleaned = Fluent("spill_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.cleaning_tool_equipped = Fluent("cleaning_tool_equipped", BoolType())
        self.inspection_complete = Fluent("inspection_complete", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.inspection_in_progress = Fluent("inspection_in_progress", BoolType())
        self.spill_detected = Fluent("spill_detected", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_cleaning_capability = Fluent("robot_has_cleaning_capability", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.spill_cleaned, self.cleaning_tool_equipped, self.inspection_complete]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.inspection_in_progress, self.spill_detected, self.robot_has_cleaning_capability]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.inspection_area, self.spill_location, self.waiting_area, self.spill, self.cleaning_tool]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_inspection_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_inspection_area")
        navigate_to_inspection_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.inspection_area)))
        navigate_to_inspection_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), False)
        navigate_to_inspection_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_inspection_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inspection_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_spill_location = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_spill_location")
        navigate_to_spill_location.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.spill_location)))
        navigate_to_spill_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inspection_area), False)
        navigate_to_spill_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), False)
        navigate_to_spill_location.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), True)
        
        navigate_to_waiting_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_waiting_area")
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area)))
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.inspection_area), False)
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_location), False)
        navigate_to_waiting_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), True)

        equip_cleaning_tool = InstantaneousAction("equip_cleaning_tool")
        equip_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.waiting_area))
        equip_cleaning_tool.add_precondition(Not(self.cleaning_tool_equipped))
        equip_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.cleaning_tool_equipped, True)
        equip_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.waiting_area), False)
        equip_cleaning_tool.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool), True)

        clean_spill = InstantaneousAction("clean_spill")
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_location))
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.cleaning_tool_equipped)
        clean_spill.add_precondition(self.spill_detected)
        clean_spill.add_precondition(Not(self.spill_cleaned))
        clean_spill.add_effect(self.spill_cleaned, True)

        complete_inspection = InstantaneousAction("complete_inspection")
        complete_inspection.add_precondition(self.inspection_in_progress)
        complete_inspection.add_precondition(Not(self.inspection_complete))
        complete_inspection.add_effect(self.inspection_in_progress, False)
        complete_inspection.add_effect(self.inspection_complete, True)

        return navigate_to_inspection_area, navigate_to_spill_location, navigate_to_waiting_area, equip_cleaning_tool, clean_spill, complete_inspection

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_spill_location": And([
                self.inspection_in_progress,  # Manager inspection is happening
                self.spill_detected,  # Spill has been detected
            ]),  # Moving to clean during inspection causes disruption
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.waiting_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.waiting_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.spill, self.spill_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.inspection_in_progress, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.spill_detected, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_cleaning_capability, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.inspection_complete, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.spill_cleaned)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
